question: Which of the following parts of the Constitution of India gives details of the procedures for its amendments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Part XX.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The process of amendment in the constitution is **committed in Part XX (Article 368) **of the Constitution of India.
 
• This process make sure the **sanctity of the Constitution of India** and retains a check on** arbitrary power of the Parliament of India.**
 
• Amending the constitution of India is the procedure of making amendments to the** fundamental law or supreme law of the country. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part XIII** of the Indian Constitution, as its title shows is** concerned with Trade, Commerce and Intercourse in India.**​
 
• **Part XV **of the Indian Constitution consists of articles connected to **elections conducted in India.**
 
• **Part XI** of the Constitution of India – consists of Articles on Relations among the **Union and States.**
